meta.name: SP to MT - SH+LS smooth pack-and-coast 48M (90% MOP)
meta.notes: Field-manageable injection: cram SP at 20k SCFM holding drive a hard 10% below MOP (drive_ceiling_fraction 0.90), inject 48 MMscf, then a single cut and coast to MT. One rate step-down vs 31 on/off cycles in the lean controller. Boosters SH+LS, 45-psi suction. LS runs flat-out to the MOP ceiling (run_at_max) to pre-build drive over the Sutton foot climb and eliminate the marginal-drive pin (no extra N2).
